title: Divisibility of the factorial ratio (8n)! n!/((4n)! (3n)! (2n)!): proofs of conjectures of Bala
description: Let a(n) = (8n)! n!/((4n)! (3n)! (2n)!) (OEIS A211420). Peter Bala conjectured that (n+1) | 35 a(n), (2n+1) | 3 a(n), (3n+1) | 5 a(n) and (8n-1) | a(n) for all n, and that the products (kn+1)...(kn+r) for k in {1,2,3} and (8n-1)(8n-3)...(8n-2r-1) divide fixed multiples of a(n). We prove all of these; the divisibilities (n+1) | 35 a(n), (2n+1) | 3 a(n) and (8n-1) | a(n) appear to be new, and the constants 35, 3, 5 are optimal. The proofs evaluate Legendre's formula through a single step function of period 24, with a short escape lemma at the primes 2 and 3. All four statements, as formalized in Google DeepMind's Formal Conjectures repository, are proved in Lean 4 with Mathlib. The repository contains the paper (LaTeX source and PDF), the Lean files, a check script, numerical checks and logs.
